newsitem.title: USA: Houghton Mifflin begins on-line store.
newsitem.headline: Houghton Mifflin begins on-line store.

text.p: Houghton Mifflin Co said Tuesday it is launching an on-line store, Houghton Mifflin School Direct, that will let customers order selected Houghton Mifflin educational materials on-line.
Customers visiting School Direct can search for products by textbook series or by curriculum, grade, price and product type.
The store offers reading/language arts materials from past and present textbook series; mathematics, social studies, and technology products will be added later this fall, the company said.
Houghton Mifflin said the School Direct site was created using technology developed by a unit of the Banta Digital Group in Boston.
